app.name: Second Look
app.one_sentence: Two minutes teaching and testing you on the creek damage people usually miss. Your score travels with every observation you make, so a city knows how much to trust it.
landing.first_line: This trains your eyes for the visit. It never replaces going.
consent.title: Before you start
consent.what: This is a usability test of a training tool. It takes about four minutes. It is anonymous. You must be 18 or older. You can quit at any time.
consent.stored: We store: a random session id, which group you were in, your answers, how long each screen took, a hashed random browser token, your device type and the version of this text. Nothing else.
consent.contact: Questions: PLACEHOLDER contact email (Alex supplies it).
consent.check_consent: I understand and agree to take part.
warmup.question: Which creek is healthier?
lesson.title: Four things people miss
test.title: Your turn
end.title: Your score
end.share: I spotted {correct} of 16. Two minutes. Can you beat me?
end.prior_experience: Have you ever assessed a stream before?
end.last_line: One visit is a snapshot. Repeated visits make a story.
end.keep_score: Keep my score for creek visits
demo.title: Judge mode
followup.dry_pipe: It has not rained here for {days} days. Is anything coming out of that pipe? A pipe still running after three dry days is worth testing.
followup.rating_check: You rated this stream Good, but you also reported {issues}. Do you want to keep your rating?
followup.checker_flag: The checker noticed something that may be {note}. Want to look again?
followup.low_score: You scored {correct} of 4 on {feature} in the test. Could you take a photo of the {feature} so a reviewer can check?
label.expired: Score expired. Tested {date}, more than 90 days ago. Retake the test.
footer.snapshot: One visit is a snapshot. Repeated visits make a story.
